description: "The Unseen Bridegroom; Or, Wedded For a Week" by May Agnes Fleming is a novel written in the late 19th century. The book centers around the tumultuous life of Carl Walraven, a wealthy man who has recently returned to New York after two decades away, and his interactions with various characters, including his mother and the mysterious woman Miriam, who brings unexpected revelations concerning his past.
